answer: The fable test I would run is Underwritten haulage operator licence with haulage authority attestation: a licence the authority renews after fleet audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a licence the authority renews after fleet audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the thread is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the tundra is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
